effect_description_eng: [Main] Choose 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Shoutmon] in its name. Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to the chosen Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may add 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait among them to your hand, and play 1 [Taiki Kudo] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
